audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagrees with the already-audited mirror at four of seven stages, and every phase reason is template text. Two of them also call Gwen 'he'.
audit.why: audits/top/gwen__akali.json records the reconciled chart as Skill / Skill / Skill / Akali / Akali / Gwen / Gwen: neither of you can fight before 3, levels 4-6 are Akali's entry window because Shuriken Flip (16s) beats Hallowed Mist (22s), and from Gwen's first item her %-HP Snip Snip! and A Thousand Cuts healing win the extended duel.
audit.corrected: phases[1] through phases[4] flipped to match the mirror, ratings adjusted, and all seven reasons rewritten with the real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and 2-item stages were both given to Akali with no reason; that is backwards.
audit.why: Gwen's spike is Riftmaker (or Nashor's into Riftmaker), after which percent-health damage plus A Thousand Cuts healing out-sustains a spent Akali rotation. Akali's spike is level 6 into her first item, before Gwen's scaling lands.
audit.corrected: phases[5] and phases[6] now state that her item spike takes the lane back, and the ratings drop accordingly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist was described only as 'She's safe inside'. The actual mechanic — she cannot be targeted from outside the mist — and the 22s-versus-16s cooldown race that decides the lane were both absent.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18 and Shuriken Flip is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, so you get more entries than she gets answers. Snip Snip!'s centre deals true damage and A Thousand Cuts heals her, which is why extended trades lose. Skip 'n Slash refunds cooldown on every champion hit, so she can chase your dash.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[3].why, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist 22s, Snip Snip! 6.5s, Skip 'n Slash 13s and Needlework 120s at rank 1; your E is 16s and W 20s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[3], phases[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Build MR' was the headline advice and the dosFull/dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles; one referred to Gwen as 'his'.
audit.why: Gwen's threat here is percent-health and true damage off Snip Snip! and A Thousand Cuts, which magic resist scales badly against — health and cutting the fight short matter more.
audit.corrected: Descriptions rewritten to their own titles, with correct pronouns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text writes 'Snip Snip' without its exclamation mark and says Twilight Shroud makes you 'untargetable'.
audit.why: Riot names the ability 'Snip Snip!', and Twilight Shroud's description is that Akali becomes invisible and unable to be SELECTED — ground-placed effects still reach her, which is not what untargetable implies.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Hallowed Mist's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1 against Hallowed Mist on 22s, so you get one entry a turn that she has no answer left for.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gwen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, and at 6 that beats the mist — commit while Hallowed Mist is on its 22s, not while she stands in it.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Hallowed Mist's cooldown.
edits.after: Her Riftmaker spike takes the lane back — percent-health Snip out-sustains your burst.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Gwen carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items each and she wins the long duel: A Thousand Cuts heals her through chip, so pick her, never brawl her.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside. Fight when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: Mirrored against audits/top/gwen__akali.json. That page's reconciled chart is Skill / Skill / Skill / Akali / Akali / Gwen / Gwen; I could flip stages 2-5 on both layers because 'Skill' and 'Akali' are the same length, but stages 6 and 7 need to become 'Gwen' and a 5-to-4 character change falls outside the applier's +/-10% band. I dropped those two ratings to 4/10 so the page at least reads as Gwen-favoured there, and the sides need a hand fix or a mirror-fix pass. Also carried over from the mirror: the full layer's 'untargetable inside Twilight Shroud' framing is wrong — Akali is invisible and unselectable, not untargetable — and dosFull/dontsFull here use 'his' for Gwen.
